items.title: e) Identification of Copper radical (Cu²⁺) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: e) Identification of Copper radical (Cu²⁺): a main subheading of 16.7 Tests for identification of basic radicals, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 346-347.

blocks.text: Saaf test tube mein 4 g solid sample lein. 10 cm³ distilled water mein ghol lein. Do hisson (parts) mein baant lein.

blocks.caption: Copper radical ki pehchan
rows: Pehle hisse mein NaOH solution dalein.
Doosre hisse mein aqueous ammonia dalein.
Deep blue (gehra neela) solution banta hai.

blocks.alt: Teen test tubes: halka neela [Cu(H2O)6]2+; thori ammonia se neela precipitate [Cu(H2O)4(OH)2] (ammonia base ka kaam karti hai); zyada ammonia se gehra neela solution [Cu(NH3)4(H2O)2]2+ (ligand exchange reaction).
blocks.caption: Cu2+ ions thori aur zyada ammonia ke saath (kitab mein chhapi picture ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Pehle step mein ammonia base ban kar do H2O se proton leti hai, is liye neutral [Cu(H2O)4(OH)2] precipitate banta hai. Zyada ammonia dalne par NH3 khud ligand ban kar pani ki jagah le leti hai (ligand exchange), aur gehra neela complex ion solution mein hal ho jata hai.
